information: The proceeds of this competition will be going to FOGS (Friends of Giant Steps), a non-profit organization that supports schooling programs for children that have Autism Spectrum Disorder. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). This competition is organized by the Cubing Club at UVU. Membership is open to both UVU and non-UVU students. For more details, visit the [Cubing Club at UVU tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahPfAIV2025#54853-cubing-club-at-uvu). This event is co-sponsored by Utah Cubing. Go to their [website](https://utahcubing.org/) to find links to their Facebook group , Instagram page, and the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
